name: Authkey
author: authkey

sections.description:
Authkey connects WooCommerce to the Authkey WhatsApp Business API. Store administrators can connect an Authkey account, sync approved WhatsApp templates, and create automations for order and customer events.

Requirements:

  • WooCommerce 8.0 or later must be installed and active.
  • An Authkey account and an approved WhatsApp template are required to send messages.

This plugin is free and licensed under GPLv2 or later. Authkey is an external messaging service; its services and message delivery may be subject to separate fees and terms.

Third-Party Service and Privacy

This plugin connects to the Authkey service. An administrator explicitly connects the service by entering Authkey account credentials. The account password is sent to Authkey to authenticate the connection but is not stored by WordPress.

When an administrator syncs contacts to an Authkey contact list, the selected customer name and billing phone number, together with the list name and country code, are sent to Authkey.

When an automation sends a WhatsApp message, the recipient phone number and the values selected for the approved template are sent to Authkey. These values can include a customer name, billing email, order number, product names, order total, order status, store name, and store URL.

The plugin stores the Authkey connection token, account ID, account name, balance details, automation configuration, and—when logging is enabled—delivery logs in the WordPress database. Delivery logs can contain an order ID, customer name, template, trigger, delivery status, and the Authkey API response. The plugin does not collect analytics or send data to services other than Authkey.

Site owners are responsible for obtaining any consent required to send WhatsApp messages and for describing this processing in their own privacy policy.

Authkey service documents:

  • Privacy Policy
  • Terms and Conditions
sections.installation:
1. In WordPress, go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin and upload the Authkey ZIP file.
  2. Activate Authkey. WooCommerce must already be active.
  3. Open Authkey > Settings and connect your Authkey account.
  4. Sync approved WhatsApp templates and create an automation.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes. WooCommerce must be installed and active.

Do I need an Authkey account?

Yes. An Authkey account and approved WhatsApp template are required to send messages.

Who is responsible for WhatsApp consent?

The site owner is responsible for obtaining any consent and complying with all applicable messaging, privacy, and WhatsApp rules.
sections.changelog:
1.0.9

Validate and sanitize automation mappings on the server, and ensure coupon automations run only after an order with a coupon is available. Remove unsupported stock triggers that do not have a customer recipient.

1.0.8

Update the declared WordPress compatibility, use WordPress.org language packs without a local translation path, and correct database schema migrations.

1.0.7

Synchronize release metadata, declare the WooCommerce dependency, document the Authkey service and data handling, improve localization, avoid front-end database schema checks, and verify baseline compatibility with WordPress 7.0 and WooCommerce 10.9.

1.0.6

Add the template ID database migration required for WhatsApp automation sending.

1.0.0

Initial release.
